item.text: {"search_note":"I found strong evidence on the outcome side, but weaker direct evidence on causation. The best sources separate “better trajectory” from “Biden deserves all the credit.” The main counterweight is fiscal: IMF says debt and deficits were still too high, so the economy was not left fully stabilized. The best evidence for external constraints is that disinflation was helped by the Fed, lower oil prices, China’s slowdown, higher productivity, and expanded labor supply. That means a lot of the improvement was real, but not purely policy-made. I did not find a 2024 source showing the economy was worse off at the end of Biden’s term than at the start; the strongest negative evidence is about incomplete fiscal repair, not a collapse in the
